office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Raul Martinez is the only candidate for this position and is running as the incumbent.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County District Court judge appointed in 2023 and retained in 2024, previously a King County senior deputy prosecutor and civil and appellate lawyer, per his pamphlet statement.
highlights: Prior work as a King County Senior Deputy Prosecutor, civil litigator, and appellate lawyer [S1]
Serves on committees updating court forms and information for non-attorneys [S1]
